description:
The compact startup hint ("Press ctrl+o...") is now showing correctly. Two gaps remain: the compact instructions line uses wrong color treatment, and the expanded (full help) view has only 5 of the 19 upstream hints and uses the wrong toggle key.

**COMPACT BANNER — showing correctly:**
```
 Press ctrl+o to show full startup help and loaded resources.
 Pi can explain its own features and look up its docs. Ask it how to use or extend Pi.
```

**COMPACT INSTRUCTIONS LINE — color gap:**
Elixir renders the entire hints line as one `Theme.dim(...)` string:
```elixir
hints = Theme.dim(" escape interrupt · ctrl+c/ctrl+d clear/exit · / commands · ! bash · ctrl+o more")
```
Upstream uses per-segment color tokens — key text is `theme.fg("dim", keyText)`, descriptions are `theme.fg("muted", description)`, and the ` · ` separators are `theme.fg("muted", " · ")`:
```typescript
[hint("app.interrupt", "interrupt"), rawKeyHint("ctrl+c/ctrl+d", "clear/exit"), ...].join(theme.fg("muted", " · "))
```

**EXPANDED VIEW — wrong key and missing hints:**
Toggled by `?` in Elixir (`handle_key` pattern `%Key{key: ??}`). Upstream toggles via `app.tools.expand` (default `ctrl+o`). The toggle key itself is wrong.

Elixir expanded shows 5 hints:
```
  Esc        interrupt generation
  Ctrl+C     clear / Ctrl+D exit
  /          commands
  !          run bash command
  ?          toggle this banner
```

Upstream expanded shows 19 hints (each `dim(key) muted(description)`, one per line):
```
app.interrupt            to interrupt
app.clear                to clear
app.clear twice          to exit
app.exit                 to exit (empty)
app.suspend              to suspend
tui.editor.deleteToLineEnd  to delete to end
app.thinking.cycle       to cycle thinking level
app.model.cycleForward/app.model.cycleBackward  to cycle models
app.model.select         to select model
app.tools.expand         to expand tools
app.thinking.toggle      to expand thinking
app.editor.external      for external editor
/                        for commands
!                        to run bash
!!                       to run bash (no context)
app.message.followUp     to queue follow-up
app.message.dequeue      to edit all queued messages
app.clipboard.pasteImage to paste image
drop files               to attach
```
(Key names expand to their default bindings via `keyText()`.)

**Where to fix:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/header.ex`
  - `render/2` compact: apply separate color tokens to key text, descriptions, and ` · ` separators
  - `render/2` expanded: expand from 5 to 19 hints matching upstream list; use `keyText`-equivalent to resolve from `Keybindings`
  - `handle_key/2`: change toggle key from `?` to `app.tools.expand` (ctrl+o) — or remove toggle from Header entirely and let Interactive handle `app.tools.expand`
title: TUI-4: Missing 'Press ctrl+o to show full startup help' hint
